household_message.text: Visiting friends for a few hours this afternoon, turn the heat down while we're out.

message_to_household: I can lower the heating to the away setting while you’re visiting, but “a few hours this afternoon” doesn’t specify exact start and end times. Please tell me when you’ll leave and when you expect to be back.

questions.text: What time will you leave and return this afternoon? I need both times to lower the heat while you’re out.
